_what: Monthly median per water body per variable, with the count behind each value in <key>__n, from the ODA CTD extract. Arrays are area-major: index = area * months + month, null where nothing was measured.
_depth: Variables ending _surf are the shallowest quarter of each cast and _bed the deepest quarter, computed per cast. A fixed metre would be the surface in one place and the bottom in another.
_missing: Nitrogen and phosphorus are not here. They live in ODA's vandkemi topic, which this project has not extracted, so the comparison a reader most wants - nutrients against oxygen - cannot yet be made.
